name: praxis
description: Spec-driven workflows: clarification, slicing, design, implementation, review, improvement, and verification — chained by craft (full TDD) or forge (fast delivery).

interface.shortDescription: Spec-driven workflows from clarification through verification
interface.longDescription: Praxis is a collection of agent skills for spec-driven software engineering. Skills cover clarification, slicing, design, implementation, review, improvement, and verification. Two orchestrator skills — craft (full TDD) and forge (fast delivery) — chain them end-to-end.
defaultPrompt: Clarify this feature and turn it into a testable spec before coding.
Split this large feature into thin vertical slices I can ship incrementally.
Drive this change with the full Praxis craft workflow.
